procedural_matters: The arbitrator decided that RRS 44.1(b) may apply. None of the boats took a post-race penalty.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GBR 2826 was represented by Claude Young (green fleet).
SGP 3562 was represented by Sean Kum (red fleet).
Michalina Wroblewska (member of the panel) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: The incident occurred in race Q4 and the wind speed was more than 20 knots.
GBR 2826 and SGP 3562 were on broad reach on bow-to-bow collision course, with GBR 2826 on starboard tack (green fleet, leg 2) and SGP 3562 on port tack (red fleet, leg 4).
When the boats were one boat length apart, GBR 2826 bore away to avoid risk of contact.
Immediately thereafter, SGP 3562 bore away as well and lost control of her boat.
There was contact between the hulls and SGP 3562 capsized.
Both boats were entangled for at least 1 minute.

The contact resulted in the following damages of the boats' equipment: Scratches in the gelcoat of GBR 2826 ranging from the bow to the daggerboard A small chip on the daggerboard of SGP 3562 The rudder of SGP 3562 split into two pieces.
conclusions: SGP 3562 on port tack failed to keep clear of GBR 2826 on starboard tack and broke RRS 10.
It was reasonable possible for SGP 3562 to avoid contact and therefore broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonable possible for GBR 2826 to avoid contact when it became clear that SGP 3562 is not keeping clear and therefore did not break RRS 14(a).
decision: SGP 3562 is disqualified in race Q4.
